biggest_catch: Per-study pay is small ($2-$15) and Hanover, NH lab sessions require being local - modest, occasional earnings.
catches: Per-study pay is modest: $7-$15 lab, $2-$5 online
Lab studies are in-person at Tuck in Hanover, NH - local availability matters
Online studies pay only $2-$5 via PayPal
Study frequency depends on lab demand; not a steady stream
Excessive no-shows can get your participant account deactivated
Study lengths are not stated on the page

c1.evidence: mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu Tuck Behavioral Research Lab 'Research Participant FAQs' (official Dartmouth domain, search index crawled 11 days before verification); pay ranges quoted verbatim

c2.evidence: Official FAQ states: 'Study payment for lab studies typically ranges from $7 to $15 (cash), based on the length of the study session. Online studies will typically pay $2 to $5 and will be paid through PayPal.'

c3.evidence: Steps from official FAQ: create a research participant account on the Tuck Sona site, browse and sign up for studies, attend the session, payment distributed at end of lab session

c4.evidence: Free to join; no fee; behavioural studies

eligibility: Anyone who creates a research participant account on the Tuck Sona site (tuck.sona-systems.com); notifications go to a Dartmouth or alternate email
notes: Standing participant pool of the Dartmouth Tuck Behavioral Research Lab. Payout range combines lab studies ($7-$15 cash) and online studies ($2-$5 PayPal), so the overall range is $2-$15 per study. Duration is not stated on the page; the time range is an honest typical-session estimate disclosed as such.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms (lab studies $7-$15 cash; online $2-$5 PayPal); time: typical study session estimate since page does not state durations
payout_quote: When/how much will I be paid for my participation? Payment for lab studies will be distributed at the end of the study session. Before you leave the lab, the research assistant running the session will ask you to fill out a short form that will be used as a record of your compensation for study participation. Study payment for lab studies typically ranges from $7 to $15 (cash), based on the length of the study session. Online studies will typically pay $2 to $5 and will be paid through PayPal.
payout_value_note: Lab studies pay $7-$15 cash; online studies pay $2-$5 via PayPal; overall per-study range $2-$15.

s1.note: Provider's own stated per-study ranges; no conversion

s2.note: Framed as small per-study pay, not steady income

s3.note: Catches cover small amounts, Hanover NH locality, no-show policy

s5.note: Timing: lab studies paid at end of session; online studies paid via PayPal

s6.note: Deduped: no Dartmouth/Tuck route in catalog (hits are Navigant CU and Kentucky FCU, unrelated)

s7.note: 'typically' flagged as the weasel word in both range statements

steps: Create a research participant account at tuck.sona-systems.com
Browse posted studies and sign up for a timeslot
Attend the lab session (or complete the online study)
Fill out the compensation record form before leaving the lab
Receive cash (lab studies) or PayPal (online studies) payment
timing: Lab studies: paid at the end of the study session. Online studies: paid through PayPal.
